purpose: Same-head Reliability v2 consolidation of the complete compiler/worker ownership inventory. The pre-v2 inventory is carried forward for unaffected boundaries and the V2-A Marking Pack ownership record deliberately supersedes the stale legacy Marking Pack field classifications.

compilerOwnershipChallenges.conclusion: Keep educational node meaning generative; Revision already owns identity, provenance and source-set fingerprints, while invalid node/source references fail closed. No additional mechanical model authorship remains justified for migration in V2-D.

Keep pedagogical grouping and mode choice generative inside governed constraints; job/fingerprint bindings and invalid references remain deterministic or fail closed. No additional clerical representation needs model authorship.
Keep learner-facing explanation meaning generative; exact teaching-point evidence is already a bounded locator resolved by Revision and artifact bindings are compiler-owned.
Keep practice educational content generative; exact-evidence mechanics use bounded locators resolved by Revision and activity-mode/reference mechanics remain deterministic or fail closed.
Keep assessment planning judgement generative; component totals, timings, objective weightings and binding fields are already deterministically derived from governed alignment.
Keep educational assessment intent and demand requirements generative; requested identities, component/objective references and mark-range constraints remain fail closed.

Keep original question content generative; provenance and references are compiler/fail-closed mechanics, while linguistic demand mismatch is limited to one targeted repair where deterministic derivation would lose educational meaning.

V2-A moves every safely constructible Marking Pack mechanic out of model authorship: subquestion max marks, structured aggregate AO totals, rubric IDs and numeric mark bands are compiler-owned; target IDs are bounded references; educational allocation, answer requirements and level meaning remain generative; complete parseable-artifact diagnostics permit one targeted repair then whole-artifact revalidation.
Validation decisions and exact-version bindings are already Revision-owned deterministic outputs; no generative ownership is required for those mechanics.
Keep finding meaning and recommended educational correction generative and independent; disposition semantics and decision derivation remain deterministic or fail closed.
Keep corrected educational content generative within exact supplied findings; target scope, finding resolution and dependent replacement mechanics remain fail closed.
Package assembly, exact-version assurance binding and artifact/reference sets are already deterministic or fail closed; no model-authored clerical representation is required.

markingPackV2EffectiveOwnership.rule: The provider links educational guidance to an existing subquestion ID; Revision rejects missing, duplicate or unknown targets.
Revision injects the validated assessment subquestion maxMark; the structured provider schema does not expose the field.

markingPackV2EffectiveOwnership.fieldClass: subquestion AO distribution, rewarded demands and answer requirements
markingPackV2EffectiveOwnership.rule: Educational allocation and marking meaning remain provider-authored but are validated against asked demands, available objectives and exact subquestion mark totals.
Revision sums validated subquestion AO allocations; structured provider output cannot contain aggregate AO arithmetic.
The provider supplies ordered subject-specific quality descriptions linked to the governed rubric scope.

markingPackV2EffectiveOwnership.fieldClass: rubric identity and numeric mark bands
markingPackV2EffectiveOwnership.rule: Revision compiles stable IDs and contiguous integer bands across 0..maxMark from validated ordered educational levels.
Revision inspects the entire parseable candidate, sends the complete actionable defect set in one bounded repair, then revalidates the whole candidate and fails closed on any remaining defect.
